name: RuO2(110) in acid at low potential: start values from Rao et al. 2017
notes: Rao et al., Energy Environ. Sci. 10, 2626 (2017): in situ CTR of a RuO2(110) single crystal in 0.1 M HClO4 at 0.5, 1.0, 1.3, 1.5 V vs RHE (GenX).

Their fits: Ru_CUS-O 2.68(3) A at 0.5 V (water), 2.19(2) A at 1.0 V (half H2O, half OH), 2.07(6) A at 1.3 V (OH); CUS O occupancy 0.8-1.0; Ru_bridge-O 2.19(4) A at 0.5 V (protonated bridging O), 1.95 A at 1.0 V; surface CUS Ru -0.08 A at 0.5 V; surface Ru barely moved with potential.

One effective CUS species (x_OH = 0: the H2O species stands for the CUS O), its height z_H2O fitted per dataset and read against their values (2.7 A water, 2.2 A H2O/OH, 2.07 A OH); H is not seen, so two species with two heights cannot be told apart.
dz_Obr = +0.35 A gives their 2.19 A Ru_bridge-O for this model's strained film (eps_perp about 2.3 %); about 0 is the unprotonated bridging O.
Potentials in V vs RHE. A dataset without a potential (OCV) takes the plain values. Single crystal in perchlorate: no sulfate, no film; the film parameters are not touched.
t_window 7.6 um (0.0003 inch Kapton) fixed; t_liquid fitted per dataset.
per_dataset: theta, x_OH, x_O, x_SO4, z_H2O, ns_B_O, ns_du, dz_Obr, t_liquid
per_film: thickness_mean_tl, thickness_spread_tl, roughness_tl, eps_perp, relax_001, coherent_tl, b_top_extra, interface_A, b_film_Ru, b_film_O
